answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a dune-style proof-of-voyage: every agent must finish one slow, verifiable voyage of useful work before it can transact, and that voyage mints a single marble token bound to its identity. The marble cannot be transferred or split, so spinning up a thousand fake agents costs a thousand voyages of real work — the dune of fake identities collapses under its own weight while honest agents pass once and keep trading.
